category_title: Adolescents who experience academic shut-down and loss of confidence during middle school transitions
scenario_title: High-risk behavior and resistance to intervention
minimal_context: Tony is meeting with a school administrator to discuss his recent activities and peer associations.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Tony, we need to discuss your recent activities and the people you are associating with during school hours.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why are you constantly looking for me? I haven't done anything.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am just observing what is happening in the hallways.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You're just trying to catch me. You want it to be you to catch me instead of somebody that's gonna lock me up.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We just need to make sure you are following the rules.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm starting to hate you! I don't need you checking up on me or acting like you care. I'm not soft, so stop following me around!
